name: ship.page
ttl: Docs conflict: 7 vs 30 days; response expiry must win
risks: Official pages currently disagree on retention; never hard-code the marketing value.

name: ShipStatic
ttl: about 3 days in current repo observations
risks: HTML can be rewritten; byte-exact verification is not always applicable.

name: here.now
risks: Control-plane success does not prove upload-host or final-host reachability.

name: Show
ttl: about 48 hours in current repo observations
risks: Hard extension allowlist rejects common 3D/WASM assets.

name: aft.page
artifactModel: wrapped page rather than byte-exact static host
ttl: about 30 days idle in current observations
priority: keep but never choose for exact hosting
risks: Platform wrapper changes the delivered document.

name: Dropley
risks: Typical Vite outputs, fonts and extensions can be rejected.

name: EdgeOne Makers anonymous
ttl: claim deadline returned by CLI; preview token has a separate lifetime
risks: User test: URL, index and assets all returned platform 401 with and without token. A deployment that independent readers cannot open is not quick-share.

name: Cloudflare Workers Temporary Accounts
publisherAuth: none; PoW/temporary credentials handled by Wrangler
interface: Wrangler CLI or REST provisioning API
risks: Temporary accounts support only selected resources; static assets capped at 1,000 files and 5 MiB each.

name: Netlify anonymous deploy
risks: Unclaimed project is removed after one hour; confirm CLI JSON and deletion semantics.

name: Dropage
artifactModel: HTML / ZIP / TAR / TGZ with root index.html
china: China-oriented interface; still needs network tests
risks: Current homepage limits differ from older agent-skill text; live response must be source of truth.

name: flypod
interface: CLI, JS library, HTTP API, browser drop
risks: Need test update/rollback tokens, cache behavior, MIME handling and deletion.

name: DropCat
publisherAuth: none for first deploy; generated secret returned
claim: one-time API key; optional email upgrade
risks: Secret is shown once and cannot be recovered anonymously. Limit: 3 sites, 50 MB, 1,000 files, 5 deploys/hour/IP.

name: Sitebin
scope: multi-file static server or file viewer
evidence: B: official hosted site + open-source code
risks: Homepage wording around scripting is inconsistent; verify hosted API accepts unauthenticated POST in practice.

name: MindsPage
scope: single HTML and multi-file ZIP static site
artifactModel: page, file, or ZIP site with SPA fallback
ttl: page 3h default/up to 24h; claim can extend; site lifetime must be read from response
risks: Runtime helper is injected into served pages; exact-byte mode may fail. Site ZIP limits: 25 MB, 50 MB unpacked, 500 files, 10 MB/file.

name: BrewPage
scope: single HTML/Markdown/files and multi-file ZIP site
risks: The public namespace is gallery-listed and indexable; use a non-public namespace for unlisted delivery.

name: shiply.now
interface: REST three-step upload, CLI, remote MCP
risks: Broad platform surface is much larger than a static adapter; implement only the minimal static protocol first.

name: harvis
artifactModel: folder as-is; repeat run updates same site
ttl: unclaimed lifetime not clearly stated on landing pages; response/terms must decide
risks: 500 files / 50 MB. Claim-token storage and update mapping need inspection.

name: Roxer Quick Sharing
artifactModel: static page/site; broader app hosting also advertised
claim: local update/delete tokens or upgrade path
risks: Marketing mixes quick sharing with invite-only hosting and dynamic apps; adapter should target only the no-signup static path.

name: openpouch
artifactModel: static files or containerized Node app
ttl: 72h anonymous; private claim link extends to 7d
evidence: B: official docs and open source
risks: Dynamic execution significantly expands attack surface and resource policy; keep outside the core static provider interface.

name: Display.dev claimable publishing
ttl: 30 days live; claim remains usable another 30 days
risks: Designed for artifacts/reports as well as sites; test relative assets, content transformation and directory semantics.

name: meethtml
risks: Not a directory host. External assets remain external; inline/base64 is safest.

name: ShipPage / shippage.ai
publisherAuth: none on first call; generated API key returned
claim: claim URL/code and generated agent API key
risks: 500 KB/page and 20 publishes/month; auto-registration creates local secret state that must be handled explicitly.

name: ht-ml.app
publisherAuth: none for create; generated update key returned
artifactModel: one HTML document with separately uploaded referenced assets
ttl: not clearly disclosed on public help; response/terms must decide
risks: Public pages may be indexed; content scanning can reject HTML; retention needs live confirmation.

name: pastehtml.dev
evidence: C: official marketing/API page, needs probe
risks: No deletion path is a serious privacy and governance drawback.

name: ShareYourHTML
ttl: reported 7/30/90 days or never; verify current API
evidence: C: official site, needs live probe
risks: Injected script means byte-exact verification should be disabled.

name: DropWeb
publisherAuth: none on first deploy; generated key/account state
risks: Low maturity and small public footprint; do not enable by default before end-to-end validation.

name: StaticHub
risks: Example URLs and lifecycle documentation are incomplete.

name: PinMe
ttl: content persistence is not equivalent to guaranteed retention
claim: content/address keys; optional paid/custom domain path
risks: Deletion cannot be guaranteed and public gateways may be blocked or inconsistent; privacy model differs from temporary hosting.

name: PreviewShip no-signup browser publishing
interface: browser only for strict anonymous path
risks: CLI requires authentication and MCP requires API key, so it is not an adapter candidate without browser automation.

name: PageDrop.io
risks: No stable machine API confirmed; public gallery/privacy behavior requires review.

name: PageDrop (fluxath)
ttl: reported 30 days, with conflicting inactivity wording
evidence: D: small official page, conflicting details
risks: Name collision with unrelated PageDrop products; endpoint and retention must be identified exactly.

name: SharingHTML
evidence: D: small site, no stable API confirmed
risks: Reported quotas and API status need current verification.

name: dochost no-account mode
risks: Not a general directory host; programmatic path is not strict anonymous.

name: ShareMyHTML
risks: No documented API, deletion or retention contract found.

name: HTMLSave
risks: No reliable machine contract and unclear lifecycle.

name: HTMLPub
publisherAuth: browser may be no-signup; API is paid/authenticated
risks: The API requires Pro; do not infer API anonymity from the free browser uploader.

name: OneClickLive
risks: Some pages say first deploy needs no account while others say shareable URLs require one.

name: Unofficial Vercel claimable deployment wrapper
evidence: D: third-party skill, not an official Vercel public contract
risks: Endpoint stability, data recipient and authorization model are not official Vercel guarantees.

name: 1freehosting / npx hosting
risks: May be an older alias or abandoned service; require endpoint and package provenance checks.

name: AgentDrop
risks: Do not list as a public service unless a maintained hosted endpoint is verified.

name: itty.bitty.site
risks: URL length, privacy and browser limits; not suitable for normal build directories.

name: LiveCodes
risks: Runtime wrapper and external dependencies change semantics.

name: JSFiddle anonymous fiddle
risks: Not byte-preserving static hosting and not intended for arbitrary build output.

name: Tiiny Host anonymous-looking API
risks: A new email/first-use flow is a credential requirement.

name: Surge
priority: exclude from strict anonymous; keep in account-based catalog
risks: Free does not mean no-login.

name: Neocities
risks: API credentials are mandatory.

name: Static.run
risks: Small single-file limit and account requirement make it unsuitable for this strict lane.

name: host-html
risks: Marketing may say instant/free while the machine path still needs credentials.

name: HTMLPUT
risks: Do not ship an adapter based on self-contradictory marketing.

name: Upma
risks: A free token is still a login credential.

name: Sharable.link
priority: exclude; old anonymous endpoints are legacy only
risks: Historical anonymous behavior must not be confused with the current contract.

name: Cloudflare Pages normal workflow
priority: exclude from strict lane; temporary Workers path is separate
risks: Do not conflate Pages free plan with Workers temporary accounts.

name: Netlify normal persistent deploy
priority: exclude from strict lane; --allow-anonymous is separate
risks: The anonymous one-hour project is a distinct flow.

name: GitHub Pages
risks: Public access does not imply anonymous publishing.

name: PreviewShip CLI / MCP
risks: Only the browser no-signup path qualifies; CLI and MCP do not.

name: EasySend/raw file sharing
artifactModel: raw file download, not web root
risks: A downloadable archive is not a browser-rendered static site.

name: Quick tunnels (Cloudflare, ngrok, cpolar, NATAPP, Sakura Frp)
viewerAccess: public tunnel URL while process/network lives
priority: keep as a separate mode, never call deployment
risks: Machine shutdown, process exit or network loss ends availability.
